planned_queries.name: connection_properties
planned_queries.query: MATCH (a:PlotBeat)-[r:CHARACTER_CONTINUITY]->(b:PlotBeat) RETURN a.beat_uuid AS from_beat, b.beat_uuid AS to_beat, properties(r) AS properties LIMIT 3

planned_queries.name: kit_relationship_properties
planned_queries.query: MATCH (o:Object {object_uuid: $uuid})-[r]-(n) RETURN labels(n) AS neighbor_labels, type(r) AS relationship_type, properties(r) AS properties LIMIT 3
